Legendary Resistance (2/Day) If the taurachni fails a Saving 
Th row, it can choose to succeed instead.
Eight Limbed Th e taurachni can climb diffi cult surfaces, including 
walls, without needing to make an ability check, but will need to do 
so for ceilings. Additionally, it is unaffected by diffi cult terrain. 
Fortifi ed Carapace When the taurachni is subjected to a spell or 
effect that allows it to make a Dexterity Saving Th row to take only 
half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds, and only half 
if it fails.
Web Senses While in contact with its web, the taurachni knows the 
exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web. 
Th e taurachni does not suffer the effects of Viscous Webbing.
Fearful Presence Th e taurachni has Advantage against Intimidation 
and Animal Handling Saving Th rows.
Multiattack Th e taurachni makes three attacks, using Crushing 
Tarsus, Heaving Bulk, Mandible Bite or Viscous Webbing in any 
combination.
Actions
Legendary Actions
Crushing Tarsus. Melee Attack Roll: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Th row: 
DC 13, target creature that the taurachni successfully hit with its 
Crushing Tarsus attack. Failure: 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage 
and the target's Hit Points are reduced by the same amount. Th is 
reduction lasts until the creature fi nishes a Long Rest.
Mandible Bite Melee Attack Roll: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Piercing damage. 
Heaving Bulk Melee Attack Roll: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the taurachni moved 
+20 ft. straight toward the target creature immediately before 
the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage 
and has the Prone condition.
Silkstone Webbing (Recharge 3-6) Th e taurachni designates a 5 
ft. square area within 20 ft. of it. Th e terrain in that area becomes 
Diffi cult Terrain. Strength Saving Th row: DC 15, any creatures 
within or entering the 5 ft. square area. Failure:  Target creature 
has the Restrained condition (escape DC 15). Th e webbing can be 
attacked and destroyed, walls have an AC 8: HP 40: Vulnerability 
to Fire damage: Immunity to Piercing damage.
Legendary Action Uses 3 (4 in Lair) Immediately after another 
creature's turn, the taurachni can expend a Legendary Action Use to 
take one of the following actions. Th e taurachni regains all expended 
Legendary Actions at the start of each of its turns.
Octa Quake Eight piston-like legs stomps the ground furiously. 
Strength Saving Th row: DC 16, each creature within a 40 ft. 
Emanationoriginating from the taurachni. Failure: Th e target 
has the Prone condition, and has Disadvantage on Dexterity 
Saving Th rows until the taurachni's next turn.
Bulwark of Limbs Th e taurachni shifts its limbs closer to body, 
preventing it from moving while increasing its Armor Class 
(AC) by 4 (total 22) until it chooses to leave this stance.
Powerful Leap With coiled limbs the taurachni leaps 
away, Disengaging from combat and can jump 30 ft. away. 
Additionally, during this movement, the taurachni can leap 
onto walls to climb.
Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) Surrounded, the spider lashes out.
 Reaction - Trigger: When in melee combat and bloodied. Response - 
Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 16, the taurachni. Success: Th e taurachni 
simultaneously attacks each creature within 5 ft. of it with its 
Crushing Tarsus attack.
Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 90 ft., Passive Perception 18
Challenge 12 (XP 8,400; PB 4)
Skills Athletics +10, Perception +8, Stealth +7
Resistances Acid, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing
Immunities Charmed, Frightened, Prone
Funneling Web Lines of webbing are found within 6 miles of 
the Lair, creating tunnels rife with dead-ends. Creatures have 
Disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks on tracking and 
navigating the tunnels, but have Advantage if they plan to travel 
to the center of the taurachni's lair.
Husked Remains Crushed carcasses of the taurachni’s past 
victims line the walls of the tunnels within 5 miles of its Lair, 
attracting untold number of scavengers. Double the amount of 
creatures from the results on the Scavengers Table.
Silk-Stone Blocked Passages Th e taurachni purposefully blocks 
exiting tunnels when within 4 miles of its Lair. Large surfaces of 
thick silk cover from floor to ceiling, but they can be damaged. 
Walls have an AC 8: HP 40: Vulnerability to Fire damage: 
Immunity to Piercing damage.
Resonating Webs Within 3 miles of the Lair, the silk becomes 
more supple and emits subtle vibrations that can be sensed by 
creatures attuned to the vibrations of the earth. Creatures with 
Tremorsense have their range increased by 30 ft. while in the 
taurachni’s domain.
Web of Life Despite the echoing chambers of death, life 
flourishes in the webbing within 2 miles of the Lair. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the discovered result.
Plucking the Strands Th e taurachni immediately feels the 
vibration of its web when it disturbed by touch within 1 mile 
of its Lair. Creatures attempting to move stealthily within this 
radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity (Stealth) check to not rouse 
the arachnid’s awareness. Any damage applied to webbing 
within this radius immediately rouses the taurachni to act.
Murmuring Th reads Drumming its smaller four hind limbs, 
the taurachni vibrates the thick threads that line the floor at a 
discomforting low frequency. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 16, 
each creature within a 30 ft. Emanation originating from the 
taurachni. Failure: Creatures have Disadvantage on maintaining 
Concentration.
Silk-Stone Barricade (1/Day) Th e taurachni rapidly spins strands 
of silk into a thick stone-like barricade. Th is 6 ft. high 10 ft. wide 
wall provides cover for the spider, granting it Advantage on 
Dexterity Saving Th rows if it remains behind it. Th e webbing 
can be attacked and destroyed. Walls have an AC 8: HP 40: 
Vulnerability to Fire damage: Immunity to Piercing damage.
Echoing Screech Th e taurachni rubs its pedipalps furiously, 
creating a painful screech. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, each 
creature in a 60 ft. Cone. Failure: 19 (3d12) Th under damage. 
Success: Half damage. 
Pinning Tarsus Th e Taurachni targets a prone creature within 
5 ft. of it. Strength Saving Th row: DC 16, target prone creature. 
Failure: 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and the creature has the 
Restrained condition (escape DC 15). Success: Half damage. 
Repelling Bulk Shaking fi tfully the taurachni attempts to push 
away any assailants. Strength Saving Th row: DC 14, each creature 
within 5 ft. from the taurachni. Failure: Target creature is pushed 
back 10 ft. and has the Prone condition.
[Seasonal] Stone Fall Ripping specifi c strands of webbing, the 
taurachni purposefully dislodges sections of the stone ceiling 
onto the ground below. Roll 1d6 for each creature in the lair, 
including the taurachni. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 14, each 
creature that rolled a 1. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage. 
Success: Half damage. Th e shattered stone remains on the 
ground, creating Diffi cult Terrain.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the taurachni takes 
a lair action to cause one of the following effects, the taurachni 
can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row.
Lair Actions
Regional Effects
Deep within the Umbrawells, thick strands of silk plaster across 
floors and ceilings, sealing off passages and funneling prey ever 
closer to the awaiting arachnid.
